constraints: All input numbers in 0..10000; fewer than 65 datasets; terminate only at N=Q=0; preserve duplicate marbles; first position is one-based.
independentMethod: Frequency counts and prefix totals compute the first rank, independent of sorting and binary search.

mutations.replace:
auto it = upper_bound(marbles.begin(), marbles.end(), x);
